### **Change in Agricultural Land Use Over Time 🌱**

```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
library(leafsync)
```

```{r}
#loading in data
past <- st_read(here("data/ag_data/Agricultural_Land_Use_-_2015_Baseline.geojson"))
present <- st_read(here("data/ag_data/Agricultural_Land_Use_-_2020_Update.geojson"))
```

```{r}
map1 <- mapview(past, zcol = "cropcatego", alpha = 0.5, legend = FALSE)
map2 <- mapview(present, zcol = "crops_2020", alpha = 0.5, legend = FALSE)

sync(map1, map2)

```
